claims.claim_text: This section describes governance arrangements for oversight of sustainability-related risks and opportunities, including climate-related risks and opportunities.
claims.support_notes: Introductory statement only; no entity-specific governance arrangements are actually described (no named bodies/individuals, processes, or frequencies).

claims.claim_text: The entity identifies the governance body(ies) or individual(s) responsible for oversight of sustainability-related risks and opportunities, including climate-related risks and opportunities.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Oversight by governance body(ies) or individual(s) paragraph
claims.support_notes: Text states that the entity identifies responsible bodies/individuals but does not actually identify any (no board/committee names or roles provided).

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses how responsibilities for sustainability-related risks and opportunities (including climate-related) are reflected in governance documentation (terms of reference, mandates, role descriptions and related policies).
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: bullet 'How responsibilities are reflected in governance documentation'
claims.support_notes: Requirement is described as a disclosure topic, but no actual governance documentation references or descriptions are provided.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses how the governance body(ies) or individual(s) determines whether appropriate skills and competencies are available or will be developed to oversee strategies responding to sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities.
claims.support_notes: Only a generic prompt; no description of skills assessment, training plans, or competency frameworks.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses how and how often the governance body(ies) or individual(s) is informed about sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities.
claims.support_notes: No reporting cadence, channels, dashboards, or committee packs described; frequency not provided.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses how the governance body(ies) or individual(s) takes sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities into account when overseeing strategy, major transactions, and risk management processes and related policies, including whether trade-offs were considered.
claims.support_notes: No examples of decisions, transaction oversight, integration into risk management, or trade-off considerations are provided.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses how the governance body(ies) or individual(s) oversees setting sustainability-related and climate-related targets, monitors progress, and whether/how performance metrics are included in remuneration policies.
claims.support_notes: No targets, monitoring approach, metrics, or remuneration linkage details are disclosed.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses management’s role in governance processes, controls and procedures used to monitor, manage and oversee sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities.
claims.support_notes: Section lists what should be disclosed but provides no entity-specific management role description.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses whether management’s role is delegated to a specific management-level position or committee and how oversight is exercised over that position or committee.
claims.support_notes: No named position/committee, delegation model, or oversight mechanism is provided.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses whether management uses controls and procedures to support oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities and, if so, how these are integrated with other internal functions.
claims.support_notes: No controls/procedures described and no integration points with internal functions are specified.
